description: Blend-mode sweep (basic): per texture set (s0 Normal, s1 Replace, s2 Disable, s3 Multiply, s4 Divide, s5 InverseDivide, s6 Darken, s7 Lighten) a lower fill with the authored 16-bit fields A (RGB) / grey A and an upper fill with fields B / grey B in the set's mode, on eight user channels covering the formats RGB16, sRGB8, RGB8, RGB16F, L16 and RGB32F at upper opacities 1, 0.5 and 0.25 (04 section 3). Sets without a mode keep the empty stack.
